- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:473-544 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reason field is truncated/validated at 400 characters even though the prompt contract says to keep it under 200 characters.
  WHY: That mismatch lets longer reasons pass validation and reach verified artifacts and REVERSAL_REASON outputs, so the LLM and code enforce different limits.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:503-525 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: codex_home is created before the run_llm_verifier_batch try/finally scope, so an exception in the gap can leak the temp directory.
  WHY: If anything raises before the finally block is entered, the mkdtemp directory under RUNNER_TEMP can remain orphaned and accumulate.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:524-552 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The TimeoutExpired handler calls shutil.rmtree(codex_home, ignore_errors=True) even though the finally block already does the same cleanup.
  WHY: It is harmless duplication, but it adds dead control flow and makes the cleanup path harder to reason about.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:108 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The model name "openai/gpt-5.4-mini" was questioned as invalid but is actually valid.
  WHY: It appears in scripts/codex_model_catalog.json line 397, so there is no issue here.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:754-757 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The bare except around verify_llm_rejections swallows the traceback and emits only a generic unexpected_exception reason.
  WHY: When verify_llm_rejections throws, operators lose exception type and stack context needed to diagnose which block failed.

- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:473 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The prompt contract in consolidator-reject-verifier.txt specifies reasons must be "Keep it under 200 characters", but the validator truncates at 400 characters instead of 200.
  WHY: This contract mismatch allows oversized reasons to reach artifacts and downstream REVERSAL_REASON updates.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:503-523 | severity=medium | confidence=3

  WHY: While prepare_llm_codex_home has its own cleanup on exception, once it returns successfully, the caller run_llm_verifier_batch assumes responsibility and any exception in the gap bypasses cleanup.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:524-534 | severity=low | confidence=3

  WHY: It is not a functional bug, but it creates maintenance burden and confusing control flow.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:544 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The prompt contract in `prompts/consolidator-reject-verifier.txt` states "Keep it under 200 characters" for the reason field, but the validator truncates at 400 characters before writing the reason into the verified_rejections.json artifact and the REVERSAL_REASON line.
  WHY: An LLM that returns a 300-character reason will pass validation and be written into review_issues.txt as REVERSAL_REASON, so the prompt contract and code disagree.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:503-523 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The call to prepare_llm_codex_home() and the construction of the cmd list happen outside the try/except/finally block.
  WHY: If either call raises, the codex_home temp directory is leaked because the finally block that rmtree's codex_home is never entered.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:548-552 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rmtree(codex_home, ignore_errors=True) in the TimeoutExpired handler is redundant because the finally block immediately below performs the identical cleanup.
  WHY: No incorrect runtime behavior occurs, but the duplicate call makes the control flow harder to reason about.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:754-757 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The bare except around verify_llm_rejections swallows the traceback and emits only a generic unexpected_exception reason.
  WHY: When an unexpected exception occurs, operators cannot identify the exception class or the failing issue block, which delays root-cause analysis.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
